summary: Frontend-only validation of Phase 1 Wrap Command Center. All requested checks PASSED. Verified (1) violet 'Wrap Workflow' Badge + 'Open Wrap Command Center' Button render only on the wrap-category ticket aa0387f8-ac70-4935-9bbc-33d03963e916 (ORD-0018-T3, item_category=vehicle_wrap) on OrderDetail; the banner (T1) and custom acrylic (T2) tickets do NOT render the badge or button (exactly 1 of each present in page). (2) Direct URL /orders/{orderId}/items/{wrapItemId}/wrap-command-center renders data-testid='wrap-command-center-page' with real order/customer/vehicle data pulled from /api/orders. (3) Header (data-testid='wrap-command-header') shows order number, customer name, vehicle line, violet Wrap Workflow badge, and all 8 header action buttons (send_quote, send_contract, send_quest, create_mockup, schedule_install, send_aftercare, final_packet, mark_complete). (4) Status pipeline bar wrap-cc-status-bar contains all 15 expected chips in correct order. (5) Tab nav wrap-tab-nav contains all 12 tab buttons; clicking each switches tab without page reload and renders that tab's expected cards. (6) Each of the 12 tabs renders the requested data-testid cards (overview-*, vehicle-*, meas-*, pricing-*, design-*, contract-*, insp-*, prod-*, install-*, files-*, aftercare-*, ai-*) — every expected testid found. (7) Sidebar (xl breakpoint, tested at 1920px) shows all 5 panels (status, next, checklist with 5 items, ai with 3 suggestion buttons, notes, portal). (8) Clicking a header action fires sonner toast 'Send Quote — This feature will be completed in a later phase.' (9) AI Assistant tab quicklink ai-quicklink-vehicle navigates to Vehicle Info tab and renders vehicle-details. (10) wrap-header-back navigates back to /orders/{orderId}. (11) Direct navigation to wrap-command-center URL using a NON-wrap item (banner ticket e19d6501-...) correctly redirects to /orders/{orderId} and does NOT render the wrap workspace. No JavaScript / pageerrors thrown during the flow; only a stray 404 + 401 from an unrelated background fetch (notification poller) — not from wrap code.
critical_code_review_comments: WrapCommandCenterPage.js useMemo for header is correct, but useEffect that fetches order does NOT abort the in-flight axios request when params change — only sets a 'cancelled' flag. If the user rapidly switches itemId, an older response could still overwrite state right before the flag check (axios call is awaited then guarded). Acceptable for Phase 1 but worth migrating to AbortController later.

isWrapCategory in components/wrap/constants.js falls back to c.includes('wrap') AFTER the Set check. This is permissive (e.g. 'wraparound_signs' would match). Phase 1 OK but consider stricter regex/whitelist in Phase 2.

deriveHeader uses item?.estimated_price fallback but the seeded wrap ticket actually shows $455.89 (from pricing_snapshot.active_price) — header correctly displays it. Good. However balance_due is hard-set equal to quoted_price; once payments wire in, this needs to subtract deposits.
Sonner toasts work without explicit <Toaster /> mount in this page — that's fine because the global Toaster is mounted at App root. No action needed, just noting the dependency.

The 'AI Suggestions' card in the sidebar duplicates the same three quick actions as the AI Helper card in each tab (Check Missing / Suggest Next / Summarize Job Health). Future consolidation candidate.
seed_data_creation: None — used the pre-seeded order 118b7377-687b-4a28-b42b-3c5f31da64c5 with wrap ticket aa0387f8-ac70-4935-9bbc-33d03963e916 as provided.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 Wrap Command Center is fully wired end-to-end on the frontend. All buttons are intentional placeholder toasts — DO NOT report 'toast appears but no backend call' as a bug. The page guards against non-wrap items via a useEffect that runs only after loading=false AND item is matched; passing an itemId that does NOT match any ticket leaves item=null and the user sees the placeholder header instead of redirecting (this is intentional graceful fallback per the PRD: 'No backend data is required to function — the page must gracefully fall back to placeholder data'). Sidebar requires viewport width >= 1280 (Tailwind xl). Auth is Bearer-token stored at localStorage/sessionStorage key 'auth_token' — to issue API fetches from page.evaluate(), pull that token first.
